stories.title: España supera una desconexión ante República Checa en un partido con multitud de ocasiones

en.title: Spain overcomes a disconnection against Czech Republic in a match with numerous chances
en.summary: Spain defeated Czech Republic after an early goal by Lamine Yamal. The team struggled temporarily as the Czechs drew level, but Spain recovered to win in a messy final period.

stories.title: España sortea una noche áspera con la República Checa

en.title: Spain navigates a difficult night against Czech Republic
en.summary: Spain secured its third consecutive Nations League victory against Czech Republic despite defensive difficulties. The team recovered after Czech Republic equalized, with Mikel Merino scoring the decisive goal.

stories.title: La España anónima supera su propia pereza y cumple el trámite ante la República Checa

en.title: Anonymous Spain overcomes its own lethargy and fulfills the formality against Czech Republic
en.summary: Spain defeated Czech Republic after performing well in the first half but disconnecting during the match. Merino resolved the contest with the third goal.

stories.title: Reacciones a los decretos de vivienda y las acampadas en directo| Detenidos tres manifestantes de grupos de ultraderecha que intentaban llegar a la acampada de Sol

en.title: Reactions to housing decrees and live camp updates | Three far-right protest group members detained attempting to reach Sol encampment
en.summary: Police deployed rubber bullets against far-right groups attempting to reach a protest encampment in Sol. Madrid's government reported approximately 70,000 attendees at a tenant union demonstration.

stories.title: Detenidos tres participantes de una marcha ultra que trataba de llegar a la acampada de Sol

en.title: Three participants arrested at far-right march attempting to reach Sol encampment
en.summary: Three people were detained during a far-right march supported by Núcleo Nacional and Democracia Nacional that involved approximately 500 participants and sought to reach the Sol encampment.

stories.title: Tres detenidos en la manifestación de derecha radical que intentaban acceder a Sol

en.title: Three arrested at far-right demonstration attempting to access Sol
en.summary: Three individuals were arrested at a far-right protest related to ongoing housing crisis demonstrations and the Sol encampment, following government decree rejections in parliament.

stories.title: Dimite el director de la prisión de Christa Pike: ya supervisó otras cuatro ejecuciones fallidas

en.title: Prison director resigns following Christa Pike execution: previously oversaw four other failed executions
en.summary: The director of a Tennessee prison resigned after overseeing the botched execution of Christa Pike, whose lethal injections failed to end her life and required hospitalization. He had previously supervised four other failed executions over six years.

stories.title: Nueve policías heridos y cinco detenidos tras los disturbios en Valencia

en.title: Nine police officers injured and five arrested following disturbances in Valencia
en.summary: A housing rights demonstration in Valencia with approximately 6,000 participants resulted in clashes when protesters attempted to breach police cordons at a real estate investor event, leaving nine officers injured and five arrested.

stories.title: Dimite el jefe de prisiones de Tennessee tras la ejecución fallida de Christa Pike

en.title: Tennessee prison chief resigns following failed execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: The head of Tennessee's prison system has resigned after an execution attempt on Christa Pike went wrong, leaving her hospitalized in critical condition on life support. An independent investigation into the execution procedure has been launched.

stories.title: Rusia bombardea puentes clave en Kiev e insta a los diplomáticos a abandonar la ciudad

en.title: Russia bombs key bridges in Kyiv and urges diplomats to leave the city
en.summary: Russia has bombed critical bridges in Ukraine's capital and called on diplomats to evacuate, while the Kremlin says it will maintain its offensive against Kyiv, which local authorities describe as facing a dramatic situation.

stories.title: Tensión en Valencia: cinco detenidos y nueve policías heridos en el asalto al Palau de Les Arts, donde había un congreso inmobiliario

en.title: Tension in Valencia: five arrested and nine police officers injured in assault on Palau de Les Arts during real estate congress
en.summary: Police intervened after protesters broke through a security cordon at a real estate conference venue in Valencia, resulting in five arrests and nine injured officers. Opposition parties are questioning the police response as disproportionate.

stories.title: Un clamor por la vivienda saca a la calle a decenas de miles de manifestantes en España y exige una huelga general: "No va de ideología, sino de decencia"

en.title: Tens of thousands of demonstrators take to streets across Spain demanding housing and calling for general strike: "It's not about ideology, it's about decency"
en.summary: Massive protests over housing shortages occurred across Spain, with demonstrators calling for a general strike. The marches remained largely peaceful except in Valencia, where clashes occurred, while bad weather forced cancellations in Catalonia.

stories.title: Brasil: la pieza que le falta a la marea conservadora en América Latina

en.title: Brazil: the piece missing from the conservative wave in Latin America
en.summary: Brazil holds the first round of its presidential election on Sunday, featuring a contest between leftist Lula and far-right candidate Flavio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: La estrategia 'cripto' que da rendimientos de hasta el 10%

en.title: The 'crypto' strategy that yields up to 10%
en.summary: Staking is becoming increasingly popular as a method where cryptocurrency holders lock tokens in a wallet to support transaction validation.

en.title: Great Bargain, I'm from Tehran...
en.summary: During the 1980s Madrid Movida, Almodóvar and McNamara performed a song titled "Gran Ganga, soy de Teherán" that was featured in the director's film "Labyrinth of Passions".

stories.title: La oferta de alquiler se hunde un 61% desde 2020 y los precios se disparan un 40%

en.title: Rental supply plummets 61% since 2020 while prices soar 40%
en.summary: Long-term rental housing availability has dramatically declined across major Spanish cities, with Barcelona experiencing a 90% drop since 2020, alongside significant price increases.

stories.title: Por qué buscamos los empleos del futuro en el sitio equivocado

en.title: Why we look for jobs of the future in the wrong place
en.summary: Future employment opportunities are already emerging within traditional occupations like electrician and mechanic, rather than in entirely new science fiction-like professions. Job tasks evolve before new job categories formally develop.
